second_method.method: printed BLUE PRINT difficulty table total (Easy 7 + Average 9 + Difficulty 5 = 21), pdf 18; independently, the answer side's keys counted

count_gate.note: Question side labels 1-21 monotonic, no gaps, no duplicates (I 1-4, II 5-8, III 9-12, IV 13-16, V 17-18, VI 19-21); answer side keys 1-21 in order (labels mix '5)', '6', '12.'; keys 17-21 all under 'V.'). BLUE PRINT 7/9/5 = 21 = audited count. Difficulty per question: easy 0, average 0, difficult 0, untagged 21.

method_notes: Pages: Q pdf 18 (heading, LO 2, BLUE PRINT, q1-3) 19 (q3 options, q4-11) 20 (q12-21). A side 'Answers: Lesson no 3 - The Justice of the owl' pdf 100 (keys 1-16), pdf 101 (17-21). Folios = pdf page. Heading title differs from index/map 'Judgement of the owl' (slug from the LBA heading).
BILINGUAL: all Kannada dropped (Unicode on the Q side; key IV line on pdf 100 is legacy-Nudi junk; keys 5-12 carry Kannada glued after the English — cut off).

Sections: s1 I mcq q1-4; s2 II match q5-8 (numbered rows -> one-pair match questions); s3 III relationship q9-12 (printed blank -> fill; printed ':'/': :' spacing kept); s4 IV fill q13-16; s5 V q17-18; s6 VI q19-21. Types by key form: vsa q17, q21 (one sentence), sa q18-20.
MARKS (R-E9): every header's N equals its printed count and M is the smaller (or equal) factor -> s1-s4 1, s5 2 ('2 X 2 = 4'), s6 3 ('3 X 3 = 9').
DIFFICULTY: none printed -> null + 'no difficulty tag'. quota_table difficulty_only; second method = BLUE PRINT total 21 (agrees). LO (R-E10): lesson LO 2, lo_source 'lesson_table'.

KEYS: q3 'A) From the soil' vs option A 'It is made by a soil' -> letter kept + 'key text paraphrases option'. Match keys print shortened/variant wording for all four rows (q5-q8) -> 'match key value not among column-B items' each (not blocking). q18 key is garbled (first sentence does not state a plant/animal difference; second does) — stored verbatim, unflagged (addresses the question in part). Typo 'From the soi l' (q10) kept.
FIGURES: none on these pages. TOPIC evs-3-03-t00 / chapter / high (R-E3).
